findings.label: const Row with non-const PesoMascot
findings.description: Both app bar title Row widgets were promoted to const Row, but PesoMascot extends StatefulWidget and has no const constructor. The file will not compile. Fix: remove const from the Row constructors and restore const on the SizedBox and Text children individually — Row(children: [PesoMascot(size: 28, mood: PesoMood.happy), const SizedBox(width: 8), const Text('Send Feedback')]).
